subject: Tradernet public desktop web hero preload

supported: All three baseline runs scheduled the exact desktop LCP image with initiator type link.
All three treatment runs modified exactly one main document and preserved the exact LCP resource identity.
Adding another preload did not materially advance the request or improve LCP under this desktop profile.
not_supported: Missing desktop preload as the dominant cause of the observed desktop LCP.
A claim that the additional preload harms production performance; the small unfavorable delta may be run-to-run noise.
causal_reading.remaining_hypothesis: The median 1.245 second gap between hero response completion and LCP is more consistent with render, style, visibility, or runtime timing than missing preload.

boundary: Public-page browser-local QA experiment only; no authentication, API calls, financial operations, fuzzing, load testing, or server-state changes. Three alternating runs per variant provide directional evidence, not field-performance certainty.
